{{Quote|Let me introduce our allies: Master Boudyn of the Jedi and Commanders Caroowar, Jiyan Dar and Yet Jub.|Supreme Commander Rans introduces Boudyn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Boudyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He took part in the [[Battle of Ilum (Great Galactic War)|battle]] on for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the war, leading [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces on there.
